pattern.crimePattern: two celebrities who owe a betting-app founder millions drown him together in his own pool at his party, after one switches off the pool camera from his phone
pattern.notes: Fictional people, app ("PataScore") and estate. Teaches joint principals: two people held him under, so the WHO group has two unordered blanks; the woman who switched the camera off also held his wrists, so she is a principal, not an accomplice.

ob.text: A caretaker reports the owner of a Runda house found dead in his swimming pool after a party: Faisal Hirsi (31), founder of the betting app PataScore.

facts.text: Faisal Hirsi was found dead in his pool in Runda on Sunday morning after a party.
Faisal drowned in the deep end. Large finger bruises on both shoulders from behind; small crescent marks on both wrists.
Wilson: at about two he heard a big splash and a shout, then the music turned up loud; at six he found Faisal. The DJ fought Faisal over his fee at midnight; Hamza, his old partner, wasn't invited.
Wilson: the pool camera records 24 hours; in nine years it has never had a gap.
Wilson: only Faisal's assistant and Michelle know his phone PIN; she used to unlock it for him.
Wilson was in his quarters all night; his door camera shows it closed.
The pool camera's recording stops at 01:52 and restarts at 02:31.
In the filter basket: Faisal's phone, drowned.
In the filter basket: a pink acrylic nail tip with a small diamanté.
Records ①: "Pool camera OFF" from Faisal's own phone at 01:52; "ON" at 02:31 was the app's automatic restore after 39 minutes.
Guest list: Allan and Michelle scanned out together at 02:45, one taxi. DJ Kaps out at 04:10. Sasha out at 00:15. Hamza not on the list.
The guests: Allan and Michelle talked in a corner most of the night. Faisal is in no party photo after 02:00. Sasha threw a drink at him at 23:00 and left.
A guest: "Allan came back about quarter past two soaking wet, laughing, said he'd jumped in for a dare."
A guest: "Michelle was in the bathroom a long time, then wore gloves for the rest of the night. Party gloves, she said."
Booth and driveway cameras: DJ Kaps left the decks 01:40–02:20 on a playlist and stood at his car in the driveway.
Estate plate log: Hamza's car never entered Runda on Saturday night.
Hamza's building guard: he was home in Parklands all night.
Sasha's taxi: Runda 00:15, home in Lavington 00:45.
Records ②: Allan owes Faisal KSh 4.2 million and Michelle KSh 2.8 million. Friday to both: "Monday, or on Tuesday the list goes up and my lawyers file."
In Michelle's flat: the "party gloves".
In Michelle's bathroom: Allan's damp grey rugby training top, in a laundry bag.
Michelle's nails, in detention: one acrylic missing from the right ring finger.
Post-mortem: drowning, with a very high blood alcohol. No head injury, no burns, a healthy heart.
Post-mortem: two people held him: a large grip on the shoulders from behind, and smaller fingertip and nail marks on the wrists.
Post-mortem: death on Sunday between 02:00 and 02:30.
Lab: the nail tip from the filter is from Michelle's set, same diamanté.
Lab: under Faisal's fingernails, fibres from Allan's grey rugby training top.
Lab: the training top was soaked in pool water.
Missing: the pool camera recorded nothing from 01:52 to 02:31.
Missing: Faisal is not in any party photo after 02:00.
Missing: Hamza's car never entered the estate.
Missing: there's one acrylic nail missing from Michelle's set.
Missing: DJ Kaps wasn't at his decks for forty minutes.

Allan: "He was going to put my name on a list on Tuesday. My contract has a morality clause. I'd lose everything." He won't speak about Michelle.

reconstruction.text: For years Faisal lends Allan money for betting losses and Michelle money for the life she is paid to show online. On Friday he messages both: pay by Monday, or on Tuesday the list goes up and his lawyers file.
At his party on Saturday night they talk in a corner and agree. At 01:52 Michelle, who knows his phone PIN, takes his phone from the bar and switches the pool camera off in his house app.

At about two Faisal, very drunk, goes to sit by the pool. Allan pushes him into the deep end and holds his shoulders under; Michelle holds his wrists to stop him grabbing the edge. She breaks a nail. She throws his phone in the pool.

Allan goes back to the party with wet hair, laughing that he jumped in for a dare. Michelle hides her hands in party gloves. At 02:31 the app restores the camera; at 02:45 they scan out together and leave in one taxi.

clockPlan.note: Three stamps, the maximum: the house-automation log, Faisal's loans, and a warrant on Michelle's flat. One detention at a time: Michelle first (her nails are sampled; the nail comparison takes 8 h), then Allan (the fibres and chlorine traces, 12 h each, were submitted with the flat search and are back by then).
